item.title: School districts face a back-to-school math problem: The high price of diesel
item.description: With the war in Iran driving up fuel prices, diesel is now nearly $5.60 a gallon, affecting school districts at the start of the year.

item.title: Tech companies and local officials are covering data center talks in NDAs
item.description: Nondisclosure agreements covered up negotiations between a tech company and several local and state officials, surprising local residents. It's a tactic used around the country in data center deals.

item.title: Jon Ossoff, usually a head down senator, has found a formula to excite Democrats
item.description: Ossoff should be among the most vulnerable Senate incumbents this year. Instead, the Georgia Democrat has opened a steady lead in polls and is increasingly seen as a potential 2028 contender.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Before an emergency hearing, the Kennedy Center's board threatens to demolish it
item.description: A lawsuit seeks to block President Trump's name from going back on the center. The center's board warns that if renovation plans don't go forward, it may be demolished.

item.title: Andrew Tate is seeking bail in his extradition fight. Here's why that's unlikely
item.description: There's a fear that people facing international extradition granted bail could flee. Andrew Tate and his brother face a total of 59 criminal charges in the U.K., including rape and human trafficking.

item.title: FDA approves landmark pancreatic cancer drug that's shown to improve survival
item.description: U.S. health officials have approved a groundbreaking pancreatic cancer drug that offers a new approach to treating the deadly form of cancer, by blocking a protein that fuels tumor growth in the vast majority of cases.

item.title: Official leading Trump's Gaza ceasefire effort criticizes Israel for its attacks
item.description: The official in charge of President Trump's ceasefire plan for Gaza criticized Israel for its attacks on the Palestinian territory and warned that the alternative to the U.S. proposal is the next war.
